question: What characterizes disturbances that arise only from bodily imbalance?
premises: Some disturbances do not appear when a person is healthy.
Those disturbances arise in poor health from imbalance of the bodily elements.
Their significance is limited to the experience of that imbalance.
inference: Disturbances that appear only in illness and come from bodily imbalance do not by themselves indicate spiritual fall.
uncertainties: nodamiṣan is morphologically compressed; the sense is clear but the exact verbal form is slightly uncertain.
plain_english: Some disturbances never arise when a person is healthy and appear only in illness, caused by bodily imbalance. These amount only to the experience of that condition.
